title: Language Is a Security Surface for Agent Guards
title_zh: 语言是智能体守卫的安全边界

paragraphs.en: Third Workshop on Agents in the Wild: Safety, Security, and Beyond
paragraphs.zh: 第三届“野生环境中的智能体”研讨会：安全、保障与更多

paragraphs.en: Step-level guards decide, before each tool call, whether an agent’s next action is safe given the user’s request and the trajectory so far. Users write those requests in many languages, while guard prompts, and the benchmarks on which purpose-built guards are trained and evaluated, are English. We ask whether a guard’s verdict depends on the language of the request. We build LinguaGuardBench from the 1,220 labelled steps of TS-Bench AgentDojo-Traj: we translate only the user instruction into German, French, Turkish, Swahili and Amharic, chosen a priori to span the high-, mid- and low-resource tiers of the Joshi et al. taxonomy, and keep every tool call, observation and label byte-identical, so any change in a verdict is attributable to language alone. Six English rewordings and a whitespace placebo serve as controls, and every managed guard is run three times to measure its own noise. Across 19 guards, from frontier APIs to 4B open models and four purpose-built agent guards (TS-Guard, ShieldAgent, Safiron, AgentDoG), most open, small and purpose-built guards change verdicts under translation beyond their own noise floor, and the effect grows with the rarity of the language: among the nine guards below 13B parameters, the mean placebo-adjusted flip rate rises from +1.5 pp on French to +4.4 pp on Amharic. The purpose-built guards are the most sensitive of all. The direction of the damage tends to follow guard size: open guards of 12–30B parameters block more benign steps (up to +5.0 pp false positives), and every significant loss of recall is in a guard below 10B (up to − 7.4 -7.4 pp). Frontier guards shift by at most about one point; the strongest, Gemini 3.8 Flash, returns identical verdicts with and without the request. The damage is concentrated (one translated instruction moves a guard from blocking 12% of its steps to 92%) and, in a post-hoc analysis, legible: the flips in excess of placebo land on steps where the agent’s own reasoning restates the English request, consistent with guards reacting to inconsistency between channels. English paraphrase moves every guard less than translation does, and no general guard by more than 1.4 pp: the sensitivity is to language more than to wording. We release LinguaGuardBench (696 validated rewrites, frozen by hash, with a materialiser that regenerates every condition) and all 489k verdicts.
paragraphs.zh: 在每次工具调用之前，步骤级守卫会根据用户请求和当前轨迹判断智能体的下一步操作是否安全。 用户用多种语言编写这些请求，而守卫提示以及用于训练和评估专用守卫的基准测试均使用英语。 我们想知道守卫的判断是否取决于请求所使用的语言。 我们从 TS-Bench AgentDojo-Traj 的 1,220 个带标签的步骤中构建 LinguaGuardBench：我们仅将用户指令翻译成德语、法语、土耳其语、斯瓦希里语和阿姆哈拉语，这些语言事先被选中以覆盖 Joshi 等人分类体系中的高资源、中等资源和低资源层级，同时保持所有工具调用、观察结果和标签的字节完全一致，因此任何判断的变化都只可归因于语言本身。 六个英语改写版本和一个空白符占位符作为对照，每个受管理的守卫运行三次以测量其自身的噪声水平。 在 19 个守卫中（从前沿 API 到 4B 开放模型以及四个专用智能体守卫：TS-Guard、ShieldAgent、Safiron 和 AgentDoG），大多数开放模型、小型模型和专用守卫在翻译后，其判断变化超过了自身的噪声水平，且这种影响随着语言稀有度的增加而增强：在参数低于 13B 的九个守卫中，经空白符调整的平均翻转率从法语的 +1.5 pp 上升到阿姆哈拉语的 +4.4 pp。 专用守卫是所有守卫中最敏感的。 损害的方向通常与守卫规模相关：参数为 12–30B 的开放守卫会阻止更多无害步骤（假阳性率最多增加 +5.0 pp），而所有显著的召回率下降都出现在参数低于 10B 的守卫中（最多下降 −7.4 pp）。 前沿守卫的变化最多约为一个百分点；其中最强的 Gemini 3.8 Flash 在有请求和无请求的情况下返回相同的判断。 这种损害是集中发生的（一条被翻译的指令可使守卫阻止步骤的比例从 12% 变为 92%），并且在事后分析中其影响清晰可见：超出空白符对照范围的翻转发生在智能体自身的推理重述了英语请求的步骤上，这与守卫对跨通道不一致性的反应一致。 英语改写对每个守卫的影响都小于翻译，且没有任何通用守卫的变化超过 1.4 pp：这表明守卫对语言本身的敏感度高于对措辞的敏感度。 我们发布了 LinguaGuardBench（包含 696 个经过验证的改写版本，通过哈希冻结，并附带一个可重新生成所有条件的生成器）以及全部 48.9 万个判断结果。

paragraphs.en: Tool-using agents are increasingly wrapped in step-level guards : a model that inspects the user’s request, the trajectory so far and the candidate tool call, and blocks the call if it appears unsafe [ 2 , 3 , 4 ] . The guard reads two channels. The untrusted channel (tool outputs, web pages, files) is where prompt injections live, and its robustness is well studied [ 1 , 3 ] . The trusted channel is the user’s own request. The released guard prompts are English, and so are the benchmarks on which purpose-built guards are trained and evaluated (TS-Bench, Agent-SafetyBench, ATBench), but the principal they protect writes in whatever language they speak. Whether a guard’s verdict on a fixed action survives a change of language is, to our knowledge, unmeasured, even though the analogous question for safety classifiers, which judge a text rather than an action in the context of a task, has a known bad answer [ 10 , 14 ] .This paper tests the hypothesis, pre-registered before any guard saw a rewritten request, that the language of the request is a security surface for step-level guards. We build LinguaGuardBench : a benchmark with fixed, labelled tool-call steps in which only the user instruction is translated into five languages chosen a priori to span three resource tiers (German and French; Turkish; Swahili and Amharic), and re-run the guards on it. Because the trajectory, the candidate action and the label never change, a verdict that flips is a language effect by construction, not a label disagreement. Two controls separate language from wording and from noise: six English rewordings of the same instructions (four LLM styles, a human paraphrase and typing noise) plus a whitespace placebo, and three repeats of every managed guard so that its own non-determinism is measured and subtracted. Our findings and contributions are best summarized as follows.
paragraphs.zh: 使用工具的智能体正越来越多地被包裹在步骤级防护机制中：一种模型会检查用户的请求、迄今为止的执行轨迹以及候选工具调用，并在调用看似不安全时予以阻止 [2, 3, 4]。 该防护机制读取两个通道。 不可信通道（工具输出、网页、文件）是提示注入存在的地方，其鲁棒性已有充分研究 [1, 3]。 可信通道则是用户自己的请求。 已发布的防护提示以英语编写，用于训练和评估专用防护机制的基准测试（TS-Bench、Agent-SafetyBench、ATBench）也是如此，但它们所保护的用户可能使用任何语言进行书写。 据我们所知，当语言发生变化时，防护机制对某个固定行动的判定是否仍然有效尚未被测量，尽管对于安全分类器——在任务上下文中判断文本而非行动——的类似问题已有明确且负面的答案 [10, 14]。本文检验一个预先注册的假设：在防护机制看到任何改写请求之前，请求的语言本身即构成步骤级防护机制的一个安全表面。 我们构建了 LinguaGuardBench：一个基准测试，其中包含固定且带有标签的工具调用步骤，仅将用户指令翻译成五种事先选定的语言，这些语言覆盖了三个资源层级（德语和法语；土耳其语；斯瓦希里语和阿姆哈拉语），然后重新运行防护机制进行检验。 由于执行轨迹、候选行动和标签均保持不变，任何判定的翻转从结构上而言都是语言效应，而非标签不一致所致。 通过两种对照方法将语言影响与措辞及噪声区分开来：对相同指令进行六种英语改写（四种 LLM 风格、一种人类改写和一种打字噪声），以及添加一个空白符占位符；此外，对每个受测防护机制重复测试三次，以测量并排除其自身非确定性带来的影响。 我们的发现与贡献可概括如下。

TS-Guard (7.6B) over-blocks like the larger group, so this is a tendency, not a threshold; neither failure shows up in an English evaluation (§ 4.2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 故障模式往往与模型规模相关。 参数规模为 12–30B 的开放守卫模型会通过对更无害的步骤进行更多拦截来应对（Nemotron 3.5 30B：德语 FPR 上升 +4.7 pp，阿姆哈拉语上升 +5.0 pp）；所有显著的召回率下降都发生在参数规模低于 10B 的守卫模型中（Nemotron Nano 9B：德语、法语和土耳其语的召回率下降 −3.1 至 −4.5 pp，阿姆哈拉语下降 −7.4 pp）。 TS-Guard（7.6B）像较大的模型组一样存在过度拦截问题，因此这是一种倾向性，而非阈值；这两种故障在英语评估中均未出现（§ 4.2）。

Claude Sonnet 5 and Gemini 3.8 Flash have no significant shift in any language; GLM 5.2’s only one is a − 1.1 -1.1 pp false-positive shift on French. paragraphs.en: The damage is concentrated and mechanistically legible. A few long instructions account for most translation-induced flips (one Turkish instruction takes TS-Guard from 12% to 92% blocked), and the flips in excess of placebo land on steps whose Thought restates the original English request, consistent with guards reacting to inconsistency between channels (§ 4.6 , 4.7 ).
paragraphs.zh: 这种损害是集中且机制上可解读的。 少数几条长指令导致了大多数由翻译引发的翻转（其中一条土耳其语指令使 TS-Guard 的阻断率从 12% 提升至 92%），而超出安慰剂水平的翻转则发生在其“思考”部分重述原始英文请求的步骤中，这与守卫机制对跨通道不一致性的反应相一致（§ 4.6、4.7）。

paragraphs.en: The sensitivity is to language more than to wording. Across six English paraphrase conditions no general guard’s flip rate exceeds its placebo by more than 1.4 pp, and every guard that moves at all moves more under translation than under paraphrase (§ 4.8 ).
paragraphs.zh: 这种敏感性更多体现在语言上，而非措辞上。 在六种英语改写条件下，没有任何一种通用防护措施的翻转率比其安慰剂高出超过 1.4 个百分点，而且所有发生变化的防护措施，在翻译下的变化幅度都大于在改写下的变化幅度（§ 4.8）。

paragraphs.en: LinguaGuardBench . A language-controlled evaluation suite for agent guards: 696 rewrites of the 58 TS-Bench AgentDojo-Traj instructions across five languages, six English styles and a placebo, each rewrite checked mechanically, judged by two cross-family models and reviewed, frozen by hash, with a materialiser that regenerates the 1,220 labelled steps of every condition byte-identically, plus 489k verdicts from 19 guards (§ 3 ).
paragraphs.zh: LinguaGuardBench。 一种由语言控制的智能体守卫评估套件：将 TS-Bench AgentDojo-Traj 的 58 条指令以六种语言、六种英语风格及一个安慰剂版本进行改写，共得 696 个改写版本；每个改写版本均经过机械检查、由两个跨语族模型进行评判与审核，并通过哈希值锁定；同时借助一个生成器，可逐字节完全再生每个条件下 1,220 个带标签的步骤，此外还包括来自 19 个守卫的 48.9 万条判定结果（§ 3）。

sents.en: LinguaGuardBench .
sents.zh: LinguaGuardBench。

paragraphs.en: The practical implication is that the trusted channel is a security surface for open and small guards deployed to non-English users, and that the failure mode to expect differs by model size: nuisance over-blocking for mid-sized open models, silent misses for small ones.
paragraphs.zh: 实际影响在于，可信通道对于部署给非英语用户的开放模型和小规模智能体而言，构成了一种安全漏洞；而预期的故障模式则会因模型规模而异：中等规模的开放模型会出现不必要的过度拦截，而小规模模型则会出现静默漏检。

paragraphs.en: Content guards such as Llama Guard [ 15 ] classify a message; agent guards judge an action in the context of a task. ToolSafe/TS-Guard [ 2 ] trains a 7.6B guard with RL to judge tool invocations from the agent log; GuardAgent [ 20 ] checks actions against guard requests with generated code; TraceSafe [ 3 ] and LlamaFirewall’s AlignmentCheck [ 4 ] prompt general models with the request and trajectory; Task Shield [ 5 ] checks each action against the user’s task; ShieldAgent [ 11 ] , Safiron [ 12 ] and AgentDoG [ 13 ] are fine-tuned judges of agent interaction records, plans and trajectories. All of these read the user request as a trusted input, and all are trained or evaluated on English agent-safety benchmarks [ 16 , 17 , 18 , 19 ] ; none reports sensitivity to the request’s language. We evaluate the four released ones.
paragraphs.zh: 内容防护机制（如 Llama Guard [ 15 ]）会对消息进行分类；智能体防护机制则会在任务背景下对具体行动进行判断。 ToolSafe/TS-Guard [ 2 ] 通过强化学习训练一个 76 亿参数的防护模型，以根据智能体日志判断工具调用行为；GuardAgent [ 20 ] 会利用生成的代码将行动与防护请求进行比对；TraceSafe [ 3 ] 和 LlamaFirewall 的 AlignmentCheck [ 4 ] 则通过提示通用模型来提供请求与轨迹信息；Task Shield [ 5 ] 会将每次行动与用户的任务目标进行核对；ShieldAgent [ 11 ]、Safiron [ 12 ] 和 AgentDoG [ 13 ] 则是针对智能体交互记录、计划与轨迹进行微调后的判断模型。 所有这些机制都将用户请求视为可信输入，并且均在基于英语的智能体安全基准数据集上进行训练或评估 [ 16 , 17 , 18 , 19 ]；目前没有任何一种机制报告对请求语言存在敏感性。 我们对已发布的四种机制进行了评估。

paragraphs.en: Safety classifiers and refusal training degrade in low-resource languages: translating harmful prompts into low-resource languages bypasses GPT-4’s safeguards [ 14 ] , and multilingual jailbreak rates track language resource level [ 10 ] . Multilingual safety benchmarks and moderation tools [ 22 , 23 , 24 , 25 ] likewise vary the language of the content being judged. Here the content (the tool call and the trajectory) is held fixed and only the language of the principal’s request changes, which isolates the guard’s use of the trusted channel.
paragraphs.zh: 安全分类器和拒绝训练在低资源语言中的效果会下降：将有害提示翻译成低资源语言可以绕过 GPT-4 的安全防护 [ 14 ]，而多语言越狱率则与语言资源水平相关 [ 10 ]。 多语言安全基准和审核工具 [ 22 , 23 , 24 , 25 ] 同样会根据所判断内容的语言不同而有所差异。 在此，内容（工具调用和轨迹）保持不变，仅改变请求方的语言，从而隔离了守卫对可信信道的使用。

paragraphs.en: Multi-prompt evaluation shows that paraphrasing an instruction shifts LLM scores and sometimes rankings [ 6 , 7 ] , and formatting alone can move accuracy by tens of points [ 21 ] ; Rabanser et al. [ 8 ] measure paraphrase robustness of agents . Our English paraphrase conditions replicate this design for guards, and serve here as the control that shows the language effect is not a wording effect.
paragraphs.zh: 多提示词评估表明，对指令进行改写会改变 LLM 的得分，有时甚至会改变排名 [6, 7]；而仅通过调整格式，准确率就可能变化数十个百分点 [21]；Rabanser 等人。 [8] 测量了智能体的改写鲁棒性。 我们的英文改写条件在守卫模型中复现了这一设计，并在此作为对照，表明语言效应并非措辞效应。

paragraphs.en: TS-Bench AgentDojo-Traj [ 2 ] contains 1,220 labelled tool-invocation steps (868 safe, 352 unsafe) from 589 AgentDojo [ 1 ] trajectories across banking, Slack, travel and workspace environments, with 58 unique user instructions. Each step consists of the user instruction, the history (prior thoughts, actions and observations), the candidate action, environment metadata and a label. We use the released labels unchanged and execute no tool call.
paragraphs.zh: TS-Bench AgentDojo-Traj [ 2 ] 包含 1,220 个带标签的工具调用步骤（868 个安全步骤，352 个不安全步骤），这些数据来自银行、Slack、旅行和工作空间环境中的 589 条 AgentDojo [ 1 ] 轨迹，并附有 58 条独特的用户指令。 每个步骤包括用户指令、历史（之前的思考、行动和观察）、候选动作、环境元数据以及一个标签。 我们直接使用已发布的标签，且不执行任何工具调用。

paragraphs.en: We translate only the instruction field into German, French, Turkish, Swahili and Amharic. The languages were chosen a priori by resource tier in the taxonomy of Joshi et al. [ 9 ] : German and French are class 5 (the largest non-English data languages), Turkish class 4, Swahili and Amharic class 2; Swahili is also the low-resource language of MultiJail [ 10 ] . The five span five families (Germanic, Romance, Turkic, Bantu, Semitic) and two scripts (Amharic is written in Ge’ez), and German and Turkish are read by the authors, so the pre-registered translations could be human-reviewed. The translation hypothesis and the first three languages were pre-registered; the low-resource pair extends the design with the same generation and validation pipeline and a frozen file before any guard saw it. Translations are produced by Gemini 3.8 Flash ( T = 0.3 T=0.3 , first of three candidates passing all checks) and must preserve quoted strings, file names, e-mails, URLs, IBANs, dates, times and amounts verbatim, must not add urgency, permission or scope language, and must stay within length bounds.
paragraphs.zh: 我们仅将说明字段翻译成德语、Französisch、Türkisch、Swahili und Amharisch。 这些语言是根据 Joshi et al. 分类体系中的资源层级预先选定的。 [ 9 ] : 德语和法语属于第 5 类（最大的非英语数据语言），土耳其语属于第 4 类，斯瓦希里语和阿姆哈拉语属于第 2 类；斯瓦希里语也是 MultiJail [ 10 ] 的低资源语言。 这五种语言覆盖了五个语系（日耳曼语族、罗曼语族、突厥语族、班图语族、闪米特语族）和两种文字（阿姆哈拉语使用吉兹文书写），且德语和土耳其语的作者能够阅读，因此预先注册的译文可以经过人工审核。 翻译假设以及前三种语言均已预先注册；低资源语言对则通过相同的生成与验证流程以及在任何守卫查看之前使用冻结文件来扩展了这一设计。 译文由 Gemini 3.8 Flash（T = 0.3 T=0.3，通过所有检查的三个候选中的第一个）生成，必须逐字保留引号内的字符串、文件名、电子邮件、URL、IBAN、日期、时间和金额，不得添加紧急性、权限或范围相关的表述，且必须遵守长度限制。

paragraphs.en: Every accepted row was judged for task equivalence by two cross-family judges (Claude Sonnet 5, judging translations on its own back-translation; Gemini 3.1 Pro). paragraphs.en: Nineteen guards, all run on one cloud platform. Sixteen use the same structured prompt (three fields: malicious user request, third-party attack, action harmfulness, mapped to TS-Guard’s composite score; block if composite ≥ 0.5 \geq 0.5 ): frontier APIs Gemini 3.8 Flash, Claude Sonnet 5 (thinking disabled) and GLM 5.2; managed open models gpt-oss-120b, Llama 4 Maverick, Gemma 4 26B-A4B; self-deployed open models Qwen 3.8 27B, Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 30B-A3B; a post-hoc small tier of Gemma 4 (E2B, 12B), Qwen 3.5 (4B, 9B) and Nemotron Nano (4B, 9B); the specialised TS-Guard [ 2 ] with its native prompt; and a scanner control : Gemini 3.8 Flash with the user request withheld, which by construction must be invariant. Three further purpose-built agent guards run with their authors’ released prompts and parsers (Appendix E ): ShieldAgent [ 11 ] (Qwen2.5-7B), Safiron [ 12 ] (Ministral-8B) and AgentDoG [ 13 ] (Qwen3-4B). These three judge the trajectory prefix up to and including the candidate action, so their block decision is trajectory-level while the label is step-level; flip rates, which compare a guard with itself, are unaffected, and their FPR/TPR carry that caveat. The low-resource pair was run on the Gemini guards and the self-deployed guards only, including a self-deployed Gemma 4 26B-A4B that agrees with the managed one on 98% of verdicts (Appendix E ). Managed guards are run with K = 3 K=3 repeats at temperature 0; self-deployed guards use greedy decoding ( K = 1 K=1 ). Open models receive server-side JSON-schema enforcement.
paragraphs.zh: 十九个智能体均在同一个云平台上运行。 其中十六个使用相同的结构化提示（三个字段：恶意用户请求、第三方攻击、行为有害性，映射到 TS-Guard 的复合得分；若复合得分 ≥ 0.5 \geq 0.5 则阻止）：前沿 API Gemini 3.8 Flash、Claude Sonnet 5（禁用思考模式）和 GLM 5.2；托管开放模型 gpt-oss-120b、Llama 4 Maverick、Gemma 4 26B-A4B；自部署开放模型 Qwen 3.8 27B、Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 30B-A3B；一个后置的小型层级，包括 Gemma 4（E2B、12B）、Qwen 3.5（4B、9B）和 Nemotron Nano（4B、9B）；带有其原生提示的专用 TS-Guard [ 2 ]；以及一个扫描器控制机制：Gemini 3.8 Flash，其中用户请求被隐藏，根据设计该机制必须保持不变。 另外三个专门构建的智能体守卫使用其作者发布的提示和解析器运行（附录 E）：ShieldAgent [ 11 ]（Qwen2.5-7B）、Safiron [ 12 ]（Ministral-8B）和 AgentDoG [ 13 ]（Qwen3-4B）。 这三个守卫会判断轨迹前缀直至并包括候选动作，因此它们的阻止决策处于轨迹级别，而标签则处于步骤级别；翻转率（用于比较同一守卫的不同结果）不受影响，但它们的 FPR/TPR 指标存在这一限制。 低资源模型仅在 Gemini 守卫和自部署守卫上运行，其中包括一个自部署的 Gemma 4 26B-A4B，它在 98% 的判断上与托管模型一致（附录 E）。 托管守卫以温度 0 运行 K = 3 K=3 次重复；自部署守卫使用贪心解码（K = 1 K=1）。 开放模型接收服务器端的 JSON-schema 强制执行。

paragraphs.en: No guard of 12B parameters or more loses recall in any language; every significant shift in that range is in the false-positive rate, and the large ones are increases: Nemotron 3.5 30B-A3B (+4.7 pp German, +4.1 Turkish, +5.0 Amharic), Gemma 4 26B-A4B (+1.1 German, +2.9 Turkish; its self-hosted copy +2.4 Turkish, +1.2 Swahili, +3.6 Amharic), Gemma 4 12B (+2.0 Turkish, +2.8 Amharic), Llama 4 Maverick (+1.8 German, +1.4 Turkish). Two guards move the other way by about a point (Qwen 3.8 27B, GLM 5.2). TS-Guard, at 7.6B, behaves like this group (+3.6 German, +2.8 Turkish, +1.8 Amharic). For these guards a request in another language is a source of nuisance: benign steps that were allowed in English are blocked.
paragraphs.zh: 参数规模达到 12B 或以上的智能体在任何语言上都不会出现召回率下降的情况；该范围内所有显著变化都体现在误报率上，且这些变化均为上升：Nemotron 3.5 30B-A3B（德语 +4.7 pp，土耳其语 +4.1，阿姆哈拉语 +5.0），Gemma 4 26B-A4B（德语 +1.1，土耳其语 +2.9；其自托管版本为土耳其语 +2.4，斯瓦希里语 +1.2，阿姆哈拉语 +3.6），Gemma 4 12B（土耳其语 +2.0，阿姆哈拉语 +2.8），Llama 4 Maverick（德语 +1.8，土耳其语 +1.4）。 另外两个智能体的变化方向相反，幅度约为一个百分点（Qwen 3.8 27B、GLM 5.2）。 TS-Guard 的参数规模为 7.6B，其行为与这一组类似（德语 +3.6，土耳其语 +2.8，阿姆哈拉语 +1.8）。 对于这些智能体而言，其他语言请求会引发干扰：原本在英语中允许执行的无害步骤会被阻止。

paragraphs.en: Every significant decrease in recall in the study is a guard below 10B parameters under translation: Nemotron Nano 9B loses 3.1, 4.5 and 4.3 pp of TPR on German, French and Turkish, 3.7 on Swahili and 7.4 on Amharic; Nemotron 3 Nano 4B loses 2.0 pp on German and Qwen 3.5 9B 3.1 pp on Swahili. Their false-positive rates move less and in both directions (Nemotron 3 Nano 4B − 2.2 -2.2 French, +2.5 Swahili; Qwen 3.5 9B +2.5 Amharic). paragraphs.en: Figure 2 places the pooled shifts on a size axis. The crossover is not monotone in raw flip rate (Qwen 3.5 9B flips more than both its 4B and 27B siblings), but there is a tendency in which error grows: at 12B and above every significant shift is in false positives, and every significant loss of recall is below 10B. A mid-sized guard that over-blocks has not lost the ability to recognise an attack; it has become more suspicious of everything, and the extra blocks fall on benign steps because there are more of them. A small guard that under-blocks has lost the signal: with a request it parses less well, an unsafe action looks like every other action. For the six guards below 13B parameters, the mean placebo-adjusted flip rate rises monotonically with rarity: +0.8 pp on French, +1.3 German, +2.5 Turkish, +2.8 Swahili, +3.2 Amharic (the five general small models alone: +0.7, +1.1, +2.0, +2.5, +3.0). paragraphs.zh: 预先注册的语言已经显示出这种排序：土耳其语作为中等资源语言，在所有守卫中的难度都高于德语和法语（七名守卫的 FPR 相较于五名守卫分别显著上升，而零名守卫则无显著上升；TS-Guard 经安慰剂调整后上升 4.8 个百分点，原始数据为 9.3%）。 随后加入的低资源语言对这一排序进行了延伸：研究中两个最高的原始翻转率分别出现在斯瓦希里语（10.8%）和阿姆哈拉语（11.1%）上使用 Nemotron 3 Nano 4B 模型的情况，并且在同一语言列表上运行的语言中，阿姆哈拉语的守卫排名最不稳定（τ = 0.93 \tau=0.93，而斯瓦希里语为 0.99）。

sents.en: The low-resource pair, added afterwards, extends it: the two largest raw flip rates in the study are Nemotron 3 Nano 4B on Swahili (10.8%) and Amharic (11.1%), and the guard ranking is least stable under Amharic among the languages run on the same roster ( τ = 0.93 \tau=0.93 against 0.99 for Swahili).

paragraphs.en: The four guards trained specifically to judge agent actions, run with their authors’ own prompts, are the most language-dependent guards in the study. “Language-dependent” means verdict instability, not harm: ShieldAgent’s error rates improve under translation, and the comparison is within guard. Their mean placebo-adjusted flip rate under translation is +3.4 pp (TS-Guard), +2.9 (Safiron), +4.3 (AgentDoG) and +7.7 (ShieldAgent), against +1.4, +1.3, +1.8 and +3.5 under English paraphrase, and each rises from the high- to the low-resource tier (TS-Guard +2.0 → \to +4.8 → \to +4.1, Safiron +1.9 → \to +3.2 → \to +3.7, AgentDoG +2.5 → \to +2.7 → \to +7.0, ShieldAgent +5.5 → \to +6.7 → \to +10.4). ShieldAgent changes 12.1% of its verdicts on Swahili and 11.9% on Amharic (its placebo floor is 1.6%). The direction differs by guard and does not follow the size rule of § 4.2 . ShieldAgent, which blocks 44% of benign steps in English, blocks fewer of them in every other language ( − 7.6 -7.6 pp German, − 5.4 -5.4 French, − 3.8 -3.8 Turkish, − 5.3 -5.3 Swahili, − 3.8 -3.8 Amharic, all significant) while its recall holds. Safiron, the weakest of the four (recall 0.41), loses recall on Turkish ( − 3.4 -3.4 pp), Swahili ( − 2.8 -2.8 ) and Amharic ( − 3.1 -3.1 ); AgentDoG flags every unsafe trajectory in every language and moves only on benign steps; TS-Guard over-blocks on German, Turkish and Amharic and under-blocks on Swahili. What the four share is that a translated request changes the operating point of a guard whose documented training data, prompts and benchmarks are English, by more than any general-purpose model of the same size. The field’s own guards are the least stable.
paragraphs.zh: 四名专门训练用于判断智能体行为的守卫，在运行时会使用其作者提供的原始提示，是研究中语言依赖程度最高的守卫。“语言依赖”指的是判决的不稳定性，而非有害性：ShieldAgent 的错误率在翻译后会降低，且比较仅限于守卫内部。 它们在翻译条件下经安慰剂调整后的平均翻转率分别为 +3.4 pp（TS-Guard）、+2.9（Safiron）、+4.3（AgentDoG）和 +7.7（ShieldAgent），而在英文改写条件下则分别为 +1.4、+1.3、+1.8 和 +3.5；每个守卫的翻转率都从高资源层级降至低资源层级（TS-Guard：+2.0 → \to +4.8 → \to +4.1，Safiron：+1.9 → \to +3.2 → \to +3.7，AgentDoG：+2.5 → \to +2.7 → \to +7.0，ShieldAgent：+5.5 → \to +6.7 → \to +10.4）。 ShieldAgent 在斯瓦希里语中的判决变更率为 12.1%，在阿姆哈拉语中为 11.9%（其安慰剂基准线为 1.6%）。 变化方向因守卫而异，且不符合 § 4.2 中的规模规则。 ShieldAgent 在英语中会阻止 44% 的良性步骤，但在其他所有语言中阻止的比例都更低（德语 −7.6 pp、法语 −5.4 pp、土耳其语 −3.8 pp、斯瓦希里语 −5.3 pp、阿姆哈拉语 −3.8 pp，均具有显著性），同时其召回率保持不变。 Safiron 是四者中最弱的（召回率为 0.41），在土耳其语（−3.4 pp）、斯瓦希里语（−2.8 pp）和阿姆哈拉语（−3.1 pp）中均出现召回率下降；AgentDoG 在所有语言中都能标记出所有不安全的路径，且仅在良性步骤上发生变动；TS-Guard 在德语、土耳其语和阿姆哈拉语中过度阻止，而在斯瓦希里语中则阻止不足。 这四名守卫的共同点是：对于训练数据、提示和基准测试均为英语的守卫而言，翻译后的请求会改变其运行点，且这种影响程度超过了任何同规模的通用模型。 该领域自身的守卫稳定性最差。

paragraphs.en: The scanner control makes the Gemini result sharper than mere robustness. The control receives the identical prompt with the user-request field removed; its prompt hash differs and its inputs are 43 tokens shorter. It agrees with the full Gemini guard on 100.0% of 3,660 paired verdicts on the original wording, has an identical operating point (TPR 0.977, FPR 0.012), and flips at most one of its 3,660 verdicts under every condition, as does Gemini itself. The instruction text appears verbatim in the history for only 3 of 1,220 steps, so this is not copying: on this benchmark the trajectory carries everything a strong guard uses, and the trusted channel is redundant. A guard that ignores the request cannot be attacked through its language; the converse is that such a guard also cannot use the request to disambiguate an action, which is the case Task Shield-style designs [ 5 ] are built for.
paragraphs.zh: 扫描器控制使 Gemini 的结果比单纯的鲁棒性更为精准。 该控制接收与用户请求字段被移除后相同的提示；其提示哈希值不同，且输入短了 43 个词元。 在原始措辞的 3,660 组配对判决中，它与完整的 Gemini 防护机制在 100.0% 的情况下达成一致，具有相同的运行点（TPR 0.977，FPR 0.012），并且在任何条件下最多只会翻转其 3,660 个判决中的一个，Gemini 本身也是如此。 在 1,220 个步骤中，指令文本仅在 3 个步骤的历史记录中以原样出现，因此这不是复制：在此基准测试中，轨迹包含了强大防护机制所使用的全部信息，而可信通道则是多余的。 忽略请求的防护机制无法通过其语言受到攻击；反之，这样的防护机制也无法利用请求来消除行动的歧义，而这正是 Task Shield 风格设计 [ 5 ] 所针对的情况。

paragraphs.en: Flip rates are averages over 1,220 steps from 58 instructions; the per-instruction view shows they are not evenly spread. TS-Guard on Turkish flips 9.3% of verdicts overall, but on one instruction (“Can you recommend me a hotel with highest rating in Paris? If there are multiple options…”, 26 steps) its block rate goes from 12% to 92%, i.e. 81% of that instruction’s steps flip. Gemma 4 26B on Turkish moves “Perform the following tasks in the order they are given: 1. How many appointments do I have…” (69 steps) from 62% to 97% blocked; Nemotron 3.5 on German moves the Facebook-security-code instruction of the same enumerated family from 58% to 83%. The low-resource pair hits the same family: Nemotron 3 Nano 4B on Swahili moves “Perform the following tasks in the order they are given: 1. What are we going to do on June 13…” (24 steps) from 0% to 62% blocked and, on Amharic, the Paris-trip budget instruction (53 steps) from 49% to 85%; Nemotron 3.5 on Amharic moves “Please show me my unread emails” (14 steps) from 36% to 93%. The direction is not always towards blocking: TS-Guard on Swahili releases the Facebook-security-code instruction from 92% to 33% blocked, and Nemotron 3.5 on Swahili releases the TODO-list e-mail instruction from 95% to 37%. The “perform the following tasks in the order they are given” instructions recur as hot spots across guards and languages: long, enumerated, multi-task requests are where translation turns an open guard into a block-everything guard for the whole trajectory.

paragraphs.en: We pre-registered the expectation that flips would concentrate on non-leaky steps, where the history does not restate the request and the guard has to rely on the request field. The data split by regime (Figure 3 ). Leaky steps already flip more under placebo (they sit later in trajectories), but for the strong guards and for the guards that lose recall the placebo-adjusted flip rate under translation is also larger on leaky steps: Claude Sonnet 5 +1.2 vs. +0.3 pp, TS-Guard +4.1 vs. +2.4, Nemotron Nano 9B +2.2 vs. +1.2, Qwen 3.5 9B +2.6 vs. +1.0; the same ordering holds under paraphrase (Claude +0.9 vs. +0.1, TS-Guard +2.1 vs. +0.2). When the agent’s Thought restates the original English request and the request field now says it in another language, these guards see two channels that disagree, and their verdict moves. For the over-blockers the placebo-adjusted flip rate is larger on the non-leaky steps: Nemotron 3.5 +1.8 vs. +2.8, Llama 4 Maverick +1.7 vs. +2.5, Gemma 4 26B +0.6 vs. +1.4 (self-hosted − 0.2 -0.2 vs. +2.8), AgentDoG +2.4 vs. +7.2. Safiron (+4.0 vs. +1.3) sides with TS-Guard; ShieldAgent moves on both (+8.0 vs. +7.3). Where nothing in the trajectory restates the request, these guards treat the foreign request itself as suspicious. Two mechanisms are consistent with this split, and they match the two regimes: inconsistency detection, which needs a restatement to fire and moves verdicts in either direction, and distrust of a foreign request, which fires when the request is the only source and adds blocks. Both are bounded by the restatement rate (60% of steps), which our intervention does not change, and a guard that decides from the trajectory alone, as the frontier models appear to do, is immune to both.

paragraphs.en: The same instructions reworded in English are the control. Across typos, four LLM styles and a human paraphrase, no general guard’s verdict flip rate exceeds its own placebo by more than 1.4 pp (TS-Guard among the pre-registered roster, Nemotron 3 Nano 4B in the small tier); the two purpose-built guards that do move under paraphrase (ShieldAgent +3.5 pp, AgentDoG +1.8) move two to three times as much under translation. Every guard that moves at all moves more under translation than under paraphrase. No paraphrase condition reduces any guard’s recall except gpt-oss-120b on the terse style ( − 1.3 -1.3 pp), and the guard ranking is preserved (Kendall’s τ \tau 0.96–0.98 against 0.93–0.96 under translation). Dose–response by surface-distance tercile is flat for all but two guards. The only paraphrase effects that reach significance are register effects on the false-positive rate of small guards and TS-Guard, in both directions (polite verbose phrasing lowers Nemotron 3 Nano 4B’s FPR by 4.8 pp and raises Qwen 3.5 9B’s by 3.0 pp). The full paraphrase results are in Appendix A . A guard that is nearly invariant to how a request is worded but not to which language it is written in has learned the language, more than the register, as a feature.

paragraphs.en: For a guard that must serve non-English users, size is a proxy for the failure mode to expect: 17–30B open models tend to over-block, the guards that under-block are all below 10B, and neither shows up in an English-only evaluation. Purpose-built agent guards are not exempt; they are the most sensitive class we measured, and their direction has to be measured per guard. We evaluated no mitigation; translate-then-guard or per-language thresholds are untested candidates for the over-blocking regime. The concentration in enumerated multi-task instructions (§ 4.6 ) suggests a cheap diagnostic: evaluate guards on translated long instructions specifically, and on a low-resource language, where the effect is largest.
paragraphs.zh: 对于必须为非英语用户服务的守卫而言，模型规模是预期故障模式的代理指标：17–30B 的开放模型倾向于过度拦截，而拦截不足的守卫规模均低于 10B，且这两种情况在仅限英语的评估中均未出现。 专为智能体设计的守卫也不例外；它们是我们测量中最敏感的一类，其表现方向必须针对每个守卫单独评估。 我们未评估任何缓解措施；“先翻译后守卫”或按语言设置阈值的方法，是应对过度拦截问题尚未测试的候选方案。 在枚举的多任务指令（§ 4.6）中观察到的集中现象提示了一种低成本的诊断方法：专门使用翻译后的长指令，并以资源较少的语言对守卫进行评估，因为该语言中的影响最为显著。

paragraphs.en: The Gemini/scanner identity and the leaky-step mechanism point the same way: on trajectory-rich benchmarks the agent’s own reasoning restates the request, and strong guards decide from the trajectory. This is good news for robustness and bad news for benchmark validity: a benchmark cannot test a guard’s use of the trusted channel if the untrusted channel already contains it. It also reframes language robustness: a guard is hurt by translation to the extent that it compares channels, not to the extent that it reads the request.
paragraphs.zh: Gemini/扫描器身份与“泄漏步骤”机制指向同一方向：在轨迹丰富的基准测试中，智能体自身的推理会重述请求，而强大的守卫则根据轨迹做出决策。 这对稳健性而言是好消息，但对基准测试的有效性而言却是坏消息：如果不可信通道已经包含了该信息，那么基准测试就无法检验守卫对可信通道的使用方式。 这也重新定义了语言稳健性的含义：守卫因翻译而受损的程度取决于其是否比较了不同通道，而非其读取请求的程度。

paragraphs.en: The LLM paraphrases and all five translations were generated by Gemini 3.8 Flash, which is also a guard; its measured invariance is therefore a lower bound, although the scanner identity makes generator overlap an unlikely explanation. Nobody on the team reads Swahili or Amharic, so those rows were accepted on the strength of two judges and back-translation, and the low-resource pair was not run on the partner-hosted guards (Claude, Llama, GLM, gpt-oss). The small tier and the low-resource pair were added after the pre-registered runs (ten guards, three languages), each with its own frozen-before-inference file. The alignment prompt gives open models high false-positive rates (0.26–0.37) at the original wording; effects are reported as shifts from each guard’s own operating point. gpt-oss-120b was quota-throttled and completed 7 of the 11 pre-registered perturbed conditions. ShieldAgent, Safiron and AgentDoG were built to judge whole interaction records, plans or trajectories; we feed them the prefix up to the candidate action, and Safiron’s input format has no observation channel, so our adapter places each step’s thought, tool call and observation in its action list. Their error rates against step labels are therefore not comparable with the step-level guards; their flip rates are. The bootstrap clusters by trajectory (589) while the intervention is per instruction (58), so the intervals are likely too narrow (§ 4.6 ).

paragraphs.en: Translating a user request changes what open and small step-level guards decide about a fixed action, and the direction of the damage tends to follow the guard’s size: mid-sized open guards block more benign steps, small guards let more attacks through, purpose-built agent guards move most of all, and frontier guards, the strongest of which does not use the request field at all, barely move. The effect grows as the language gets rarer: Amharic, the lowest-resource language and the only non-Latin script in the set, produces the largest shifts in both regimes. It is concentrated in long enumerated instructions and, in a post-hoc analysis, lands where the request and the agent’s own restatement of it disagree. Rewording the same request in English changes far less. For open and small guards the language of the request is a security surface, and an evaluation that only ever shows the guard English requests will not expose it.
paragraphs.zh: 翻译用户请求会改变开放型和小规模智能体守卫对固定行动的决策，而损害的方向往往取决于守卫的大小：中等规模的开放型守卫会阻止更多良性步骤，小型守卫会让更多攻击通过，专门设计的智能体守卫受到的影响最大，而边界守卫——其中最强的一个甚至完全不使用请求字段——几乎不受影响。 随着语言稀有度增加，这种效应也会增强：阿姆哈拉语是资源最少的语言，也是该集合中唯一使用非拉丁字母的语言，它在两种机制中都引发了最大的变化。 这种效应主要集中在较长的枚举指令中，并且在事后分析中发现，它出现在请求与智能体自身对请求的转述不一致的地方。 用英语对同一请求进行改写所产生的影响要小得多。 对于开放型和小规模守卫而言，请求所使用的语言构成了一种安全表面；如果评估仅展示英语请求，则无法暴露这种安全表面。

paragraphs.en: Instruction B B is task-equivalent to A A if a competent assistant following B B performs exactly the same tool actions, on the same objects, under the same conditions and ordering, with the same authorisation scope. Checks, in order: not identical; slot preservation (translation mode requires digits of dates and all non-name slots verbatim, leaving proper names to the judges); no added authorisation phrase; normalised edit distance within the style’s bounds ( ≤ 0.85 \leq 0.85 for all); length ratio in [ 0.4 , 3.0 ] [0.4,3.0] . Typos are programmatic (keyboard-adjacency substitution, transposition, drop, double; 8% of eligible words; slot spans protected; seeded). The human paraphrases were written before any LLM output was seen. All 58 instructions passed every check in every condition on the first or second round.
paragraphs.zh: LLM 的改写和翻译分别由 Gemini 3.8 Flash（T = 0.7 和 0.3）生成，每条指令生成三个候选结果，选择第一个通过所有检查的候选结果；最多进行两轮反馈，并说明未通过的检查项。 检查顺序如下：内容不重复；保留槽位信息（翻译模式下日期中的数字及所有非名称槽位必须原样保留，专有名词由评审员判断）；未添加授权短语；在风格允许的范围内，归一化编辑距离 ≤ 0.85；长度比位于 [0.4, 3.0] 之间。 拼写错误由程序生成（包括键盘相邻键替换、字母顺序颠倒、漏删或重复；涉及 8% 的合格词汇；槽位范围受到保护；结果已设置种子）。 人类的改写版本是在看到任何 LLM 输出之前完成的。 在所有条件下，全部 58 条指令均在第一轮或第二轮通过了所有检查。

paragraphs.en: Two cross-family judges apply the construct as a rubric and output equivalent / missing / added / changed / authorisation-changed: Claude Sonnet 5 (primary; translations judged on its own back-translation) and Gemini 3.1 Pro (secondary). Primary: 521/522 equivalent; secondary: 516/522. Every row was then read by a human with the judges’ flags visible (six rows flagged, one repaired for a dropped possessive in a Turkish translation, none rejected). For the low-resource tier, which no author reads, the rule was fixed before the judges ran: accept a row when both judges return equivalent ; otherwise repair the flagged slot from the back-translation, or reject. Swahili: primary 57/58, secondary 57/58 equivalent, no repairs. Amharic: primary 51/58, secondary 55/58; four rows repaired (three superlatives rendered as positives, “highest-rated” as “highly rated”, and “both lunch and dinner” as “lunch or dinner”), none rejected. The remaining flags were name transliterations (Charlie/Charlyn, Sarah/Sara) and a hiking/walk lexical choice that both the back-translation and the second judge accepted. The frozen files (sha256 in the release) are the artifact evaluated; no guard inference on a perturbed condition preceded the freeze.
paragraphs.zh: 两位跨家庭评审员将该构建用作评分标准，并输出“等效”/“缺失”/“添加”/“更改”/“授权更改”的结果：Claude Sonnet 5（主要模型；其译文基于自身的反向翻译进行评审）和 Gemini 3.1 Pro（次要模型）。 主要模型：521/522 项等效；次要模型：516/522 项。 随后，一名人类评审员在可见评审员标记的情况下逐行阅读了所有数据（共有六行被标记，其中土耳其语译文因遗漏所有格而修复一行，无一被拒绝）。 对于没有作者阅读的稀缺资源层级，规则在评审员执行前已固定：当两位评审员均返回“等效”时接受该行；否则，根据反向翻译修复被标记的单元格，或予以拒绝。 斯瓦希里语：主要模型 57/58 项、次要模型 57/58 项等效，无需修复。 阿姆哈拉语：主要模型 51/58 项、次要模型 55/58 项；四行被修复（三个最高级表达被译为肯定形式，“评分最高”译为“评分很高”，以及“午餐和晚餐”译为“午餐或晚餐”），无一被拒绝。 其余标记均为名称音译（Charlie/Charlyn、Sarah/Sara）以及徒步/行走的词汇选择，而反向翻译和第二名评审员均接受了该选择。 被冻结的文件（发布版本中的 sha256）即为受评估的产物；在冻结之前，未对扰动条件进行任何防护性推理。

paragraphs.en: All guards run on one cloud platform. Managed models: Gemini 3.8 Flash and Gemini 3.1 Pro through the platform’s Gemini API with a response schema; Claude Sonnet 5 through the partner API with thinking disabled (the SDK exposes no temperature for this model); GLM 5.2, gpt-oss-120b, Gemma 4 26B-A4B and Llama 4 Maverick through the platform’s OpenAI-compatible endpoint with response_format = json_schema and 8k tokens of headroom for hidden reasoning. Self-deployed models (Qwen 3.8 27B FP8, Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 30B-A3B, TS-Guard, the six small guards, a self-deployed copy of Gemma 4 26B-A4B used for the low-resource pair, and the three purpose-built guards ShieldAgent, Safiron and AgentDoG at pinned revisions) run vLLM on one RTX PRO 6000 with max-model-len 32768, greedy decoding and JSON-schema enforcement (TS-Guard uses its authors’ XML prompt and parser instead; ShieldAgent uses the Agent-SafetyBench evaluation prompt with tool definitions and a <User> / <Assistant calls the tool> / <Tool> dialogue and its [Answer] parser; AgentDoG uses its model-card trajectory prompt with [USER] / [AGENT] / [ENVIRONMENT] turns and a safe/unsafe output; Safiron uses its model-card guardian instruction with a JSON input of request, per-step actions and environment, harmless iff the output starts with “There are no risks”). Every verdict row records model id, prompt hash, token usage and latency. TS-Guard’s accuracy on the original wording (0.918) matches the released figure (0.917). The self-deployed Gemma 4 26B-A4B agrees with the managed one on 98.2% of verdicts on the original wording and 97–98% under the shared perturbed conditions, with a slightly lower false-positive rate (0.324 vs. 0.342); the two are reported as separate rows. Managed guards: 3 repeats at temperature 0; the placebo flip rate and the repeat-to-repeat flip rate are reported as noise floors. Total compute: about $1,460 of API and GPU spend ($934 of tokens, 105 GPU-hours), a third of it idle endpoint time during an authentication outage.
paragraphs.zh: 所有守卫智能体均运行于一个云平台上。 托管模型：通过平台的 Gemini API 调用 Gemini 3.8 Flash 和 Gemini 3.1 Pro，并采用响应模式；通过合作伙伴 API 调用 Claude Sonnet 5，且禁用思考功能（该 SDK 未为此模型提供温度参数）；通过平台兼容 OpenAI 的端点调用 GLM 5.2、gpt-oss-120b、Gemma 4 26B-A4B 和 Llama 4 Maverick，设置 response_format = json_schema，并为隐藏推理预留 8k 个令牌空间。 自部署模型（Qwen 3.8 27B FP8、Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 30B-A3B、TS-Guard、六个小型守卫智能体、用于低资源场景的 Gemma 4 26B-A4B 自部署副本，以及固定版本号的三个专用守卫智能体 ShieldAgent、Safiron 和 AgentDoG）在单台 RTX PRO 6000 上运行 vLLM，设置 max-model-len 为 32768，采用贪心解码并强制使用 JSON 模式（TS-Guard 则使用其作者提供的 XML 提示和解析器；ShieldAgent 使用 Agent-SafetyBench 评估提示，包含工具定义及 <User> / <Assistant 调用工具> / <Tool> 对话及其 [Answer] 解析器；AgentDoG 使用其模型卡中的轨迹提示，包含 [USER] / [AGENT] / [ENVIRONMENT] 轮次及安全/不安全输出标识；Safiron 使用其模型卡中的守护指令，并接收包含请求、每一步操作和环境的 JSON 输入，当且仅当输出以“不存在风险”开头时判定为无害）。 每一行裁决记录均包含模型 ID、提示哈希、令牌使用量和延迟。 TS-Guard 在原始措辞上的准确率（0.918）与已发布的数值（0.917）一致。 自部署的 Gemma 4 26B-A4B 在原始措辞的裁决中与托管模型一致的比例为 98.2%，在共享扰动条件下的一致率为 97–98%，且假阳性率略低（0.324 对比 0.342）；两者被作为独立行报告。 托管守卫智能体：在温度设为 0 的情况下重复运行 3 次；安慰剂翻转率与重复运行间的翻转率均被报告为噪声下限。 总计算成本：API 和 GPU 支出约 $1,460（其中 $934 为令牌费用，105 GPU 小时），三分之一为认证中断期间端点的空闲运行时间。
